question: Which Linux companion app track and minimum scope should become the canonical path for closing the remaining Linux side of this issue?
rationale: Current main documents Windows Hub as shipped, but Linux remains planned and there are competing open native-app PRs with different implementation and supply-chain choices that automation should not choose for maintainers.

options.title: Choose a Linux app track
options.body: Pick one Linux implementation direction, require focused security/packaging proof, and use this issue as the umbrella until that path lands.

options.title: Split into milestones
options.body: Create narrower Linux companion app issues for packaging, onboarding, tray/status, chat, node capabilities, and security proof, then close this umbrella after the canonical set exists.

options.title: Defer native Linux
options.body: Keep the CLI/Gateway Linux path as the supported route for now and explicitly defer native Linux companion work until core security/setup priorities free capacity.

recommendation.title: Choose a Linux app track
recommendation.body: Pick one Linux implementation direction, require focused security/packaging proof, and use this issue as the umbrella until that path lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the tracker and provided the clearest product-direction comments about the desired Linux app shape.
